 Joe Burrow’s rumored girlfriend Olivia Ponton shows off Spain adventures as Bengals face Falcons in Madrid 
 By 
 Bridget Reilly 
 Published 
 Nov. 8, 2026, 10:41 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make New York Post a Preferred Source 
 Olivia Ponton has made the trip to Spain.
 The 24-year-old model shared various Instagram stories , showing she took the flight to Madrid as her rumored boyfriend and Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow takes on the Falcons at Bernabéu Stadium on Sunday morning.
 Ponton shared an image of Puerta de Alcalá — the city’s most famous arch located in the Plaza de la Independencia next to El Retiro Park.
 She also shared a picture of herself at Italian restaurant Bel Mondo, holding up a Aperol spritz and pasta dish. 
 “One Aperol spritz & truffel pasta pls,” Ponton wrote over the image.
 4 
 Olivia Ponton at an Italian restaurant in Madrid, seemingly as part of a trip to attend the Bengals game on Sunday. Instagram @olivia.ponton

 She also detailed that she got a matcha from Jade and churros while on her trip. 
 “Oh I get the hype now,” she wrote about the latter.
 Despite neither of them publicly addressing their relationship status, Burrow and Ponton have been linked since December 2024, when the model reported a break-in while staying at the three-time Pro Bowler’s Ohio home.
 4 
 Joe Burrow’s rumored girlfriend Olivia Ponton posted a picture of the Puerta de Alcalá as she appears to be on a trip to Madrid to support the quarterback. Instagram @olivia.ponton 
 Ponton reportedly identified herself as Burrow’s employee at the time. 
 “So obviously everybody has heard what has happened,” the 29-year-old said in a statement after the break-in at a Bengals press conference, but did not mention Ponton by name. “I feel like my privacy has been violated in more ways than one. And way more is already out there than I would want out there and that I care to share, so that’s all I got to say about that.”
 However, since then the two have been spotted publicly together including at a Bengals practice in August. 
 4 
 Olivia Ponton shares a pictures of churros from her time in Madrid. Instagram @olivia.ponton 
 4 
 Joe Burrow and Olivia Ponton are seen attending a star-studded 2026 Met Gala after party at Zero Bond in New York on May 4, 2026. 
 Melanie Miller / BACKGRID 
 The rumored couple attended the Fanatics Flag Football Classic party hosted by Tom Brady in March this year. 
 They also made appearances at a pool party in L.A. that same month and were seen at a Met Gala after-party together in May.
 The Bengals (5-2) were pushing to get on a four-game win streak against the Falcons (3-5).
 Heading into Sunday, Burrow has thrown 2,115 yards for a league-leading 20 touchdowns. 
 Burrow started the game 16-for-18 with 194 yards, two passing touchdowns and a rushing touchdown with roughly four minutes left in the second quarter.
